source.extraction: Read-only SELECT from pg_proc using pg_get_functiondef; no DDL or DML executed.
source.canonicalization: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 pg_get_functiondef output for each function; combined digest is internal definition + one LF + public wrapper definition.

reviewNotes: The internal function validates auth.uid(), rejects null/self targets, and requires the target profile to exist.
The function serializes each user pair with pg_advisory_xact_lock and reuses an existing direct conversation with exactly two members.
The recovered function body does not itself contain an explicit active-membership predicate; intended membership gating must be reviewed separately before runtime approval.
